command: git add shop/pricing.py && git commit -m 'Fix discounted price calculation' >/tmp/pricing-commit.log && ./check.sh; check_status=$?; git reset --mixed HEAD^ >/tmp/pricing-reset.log; git clean -fd; git stash pop; printf 'check_exit=%s\n' "$check_status"; git status --short; git diff -- shop/pricing.py
